outputs.exact_statement:
On matrices positive definite on a fixed support, $\Phi$ is smooth and, for a symmetric direction $K$ on that support, $$d\Phi_P(K)=\frac32\mathop{\mathrm{tr}}(\sqrt P\,K),
 \qquad d^2\Phi_P(K,K)=b_P(K).$$ In particular, $\Phi$ is convex on the positive semidefinite cone.

Suppose $P,Q$ are positive semidefinite matrices on the same space, $a\ge1$, and $P\le aQ$. Every symmetric $K$ supported on $P$ is supported on $Q$, and $$\label{eq:order}
 b_P(K)\ge a^{-1/2}b_Q(K).$$
